description.value: At 12th, and every two levels thereafter, a black mage learns further talents to assist him in manipulating spells and other forms of magic. He may choose one of the following advanced mage talents in place of a mage talent. Talents marked with an asterisk add effects to a black mage's spellcasting ability. Only one of these talents can be applied to an individual spell and the decision must be made before the spell is cast.
